answer: GaleBridge Mechanism Each agent identity must anchor to a physical sensor node that emits a unique ambient noise signature—like wind through reeds at dawn. Operators cannot fabricate this gale-like signal without deploying actual hardware in real terrain. The system verifies temporal consistency of the whisper-like background spectrum using cross-node triangulation. An attacker must place multiple sensor nodes across distinct geographic zones, each costing $800+ in solar-powered hardware, shipping, and site setup. Each fake identity thus incurs non-replicable physical deployment costs.
